turns.customer: Hi, I have a Samsung Galaxy S23 128GB with a cracked screen. I can add 100k. What is it worth?
turns.reply:
Hi! Dead phone? Let's turn it into a working one.

This chat only does iPhone trade-ins toward an iPhone from our stock, so I can't value a Samsung Galaxy S23. Android phones are handled by the store directly, and I can't give you a figure for it here.

If you have an iPhone you'd like to trade in, tell me the model, the storage in GB and what is wrong with it, and I'll work out its value and show you phones you can take with your 100k.

valuation_before_phones.detail: no turn used both value_trade_in and find_phones
